description: This file contains shell functions related to preparing and managing 'gates' and continuous integration steps for a software project. It includes functions for preparing build, test, and documentation checks, as well as managing change logs and verifying the state of the repository.

methods.name: run_prepare_push_retry_gates
methods.description: Sets up dependencies, builds, tests, and verifies changelog and documentation updates, with logic for reusing previous gates results or performing fresh checks.

methods.name: prepare_gates
methods.description: Main function that handles preparing the environment, checking file changes, determining if only documentation changes occurred, running build/test steps, and saving environment variables related to the gate status.
